obligations.description: Result should remain non-negative under validated inputs

assumptions.description: Balance must be non-negative prior to withdrawal operation
assumptions.justification: Standard financial account invariant; negative balances are not valid starting states for a withdrawal function

assumptions.description: Withdrawal amount must be non-negative; withdrawing a negative amount would be equivalent to a deposit and is not valid input for this function
assumptions.justification: Function semantics require amount to represent a non-negative quantity to be deducted; negative values would invert the operation
